name: Neon
description: Manage Postgres projects and branches, run SQL, and inspect schemas in Neon.

methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Neon in the browser. Open Advanced to pin one project or enable read-only mode. Write tools start enabled and remain governed by Paperclip's action policies.
methods.label: Sign in with Neon
warnings: A Neon account. The hosted server grants broad project and database management, so use a development project and review write actions before connecting production data.
Neon recommends its hosted server for development and testing. Review write and destructive actions before execution.

tenantFields.label: Pin to project ID
tenantFields.helperMd: Optional. Restrict this connection to one project. Copy the project ID from Neon Console → Project settings → General.

tenantFields.label: Read-only mode
tenantFields.helperMd: Enable this to limit SQL to SELECT queries and schema inspection.

methods.whenToUse: Use a restricted customer-owned key when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Use a customer-created Neon API key. Prefer a project-scoped key for one development project; personal and organization keys reach every project they can access. Write tools start enabled and remain governed by Paperclip's action policies.
methods.label: Use an API key

credentialFields.label: Neon API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Project, branch, compute, snapshot, SQL and schema changes within the key’s reach. A project-scoped key limits access to one project with Editor rights; personal and organization keys reach every project they can access. Paperclip cannot increase an existing key’s permissions.
